recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in 1970s-era casual and western-influenced attire posed in a vast, rippled sand dune landscape under a hazy, pale sky. The composition is anchored by a central figure sitting on a wooden crate, with others standing or sitting around him, creating a triangular formation.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered against a minimalist horizon line
High-contrast shadows cast by low-angle sunlight on sand ripples
Typographic header integrated into the upper third of the frame
Warm earth tones of the sand contrasting with the cool blues and reds of the clothing
coreInvariants: Rippled sand texture in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-ground central cluster, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure in overalls and a cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold header text, drops to the central figure, then follows the diagonal lines of the dunes and shadows outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and foreground sand provide significant breathing room.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in shadows and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and sky blue in shirts
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the sand; shadows provide deep value contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans-Serif with Art Nouveau influences
letterConstructionRules: Distinctive rounded terminals and circular counters
Stylized ligatures or decorative diamond separators between words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for the entire header for a cohesive, graphic look.
graphicDevices: Diamond-shaped glyph used as a word separator

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, rounded aesthetic of the era
Provides the necessary geometric weight and 70s feel
Matches the heavy, rounded, display-centric nature of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of five men in 1970s casual clothing (denim, patterned shirts, cowboy hats) posed in a vast desert of rippled sand dunes. The lighting is low-angle sunset, creating long, dark shadows. The sky is a pale, hazy blue-to-pink gradient. Film grain and slight vintage color fading applied.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, heavy geometric display text in the upper third of the image. Use a font like Blippo or Bauhaus in black. Use a small diamond symbol to separate phrases.

verificationChecks: Is the sand texture highly detailed with visible ripples?
Are the shadows long and cast to the side?
Is the typography heavy and geometric?
Does the color palette feel like a faded 1970s photograph?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
Specific 70s clothing items (e.g., bell-bottoms vs. straight leg)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Original record label logos and catalog numbers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that shadows align with the light source indicated by the sky.
Verify that the clothing styles do not include modern elements.
Confirm the sand texture is not blurred or smoothed out.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1970s desert group portrait with heavy, geometric display typography centered at the top, utilizing a warm, desaturated analog film aesthetic.
